title: Neodustria Phase 23.1 Causal Muse & Compositional Rescue Audit
hypothesis_tested: Does Meta Muse structural reasoning provide incremental causal improvement over an equally equipped non-LLM classical method?

audit_findings.finding_1: When classical optimization is provided the same breadth screening policy and the same folded-floating-shuttle rescue template (Arm C), it achieves 100.0% feasible yield with exactly 3.00 FEA calls, identical to Neodustria Arm F.
audit_findings.finding_2: The reported 30.0% advantage of Neodustria over Arm 2 (70.0%) was caused by search breadth scheduling and compositional topology access, not by autonomous generative LLM discovery.
audit_findings.finding_3: Unconstrained Meta Muse proposes structurally sound grammar concepts (e.g. differential decoupling, nested folding) but requires calibrated numerical priors to prevent nonlinear axial locking.
audit_findings.value_proposition_refinement: Meta Muse acts as an effective interactive explainer, failure diagnostician, and grammar synthesizer, but classical deterministic search with dimensionless surrogate guidance provides equal computational efficacy.
